name: LLM Bridge
description: Send PaperTodo todos and paper content to any OpenAI-compatible LLM (base URL + API key); answers are written into notes.

settings.name: Base URL
settings.description: Root of an OpenAI-compatible API, for example https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1. /chat/completions is appended automatically.

settings.name: API key
settings.description: Sent as a Bearer token. Stored in plain text inside plugins/data; use a local or self-hosted endpoint if that is not acceptable.

settings.name: Model
settings.description: Model ID sent with every request, for example gpt-4o-mini, deepseek-chat or qwen-plus.

settings.name: Request timeout (seconds)
settings.description: How long to wait for a completion before giving up. Reasoning models can be slow; 240 seconds is a reasonable default.

settings.name: Enable on startup
settings.description: Automatically create a hidden LLM Bridge plugin paper to keep the global todo and top-bar actions available.

settings.name: System prompt
settings.description: Sent as the system message on every request. Leave empty to send none.

settings.name: Temperature
settings.description: Sampling temperature sent with requests. -1 means the field is not sent at all (recommended for reasoning models).

zh.name: LLM 桥接
zh.description: 把 PaperTodo 待办和纸片内容发送给任意 OpenAI 兼容大模型（Base URL + API Key），回答写入笔记。

baseUrl.name: Base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI 兼容 API 根地址，例如 https://api.openai.com/v1、https://api.deepseek.com/v1 或 http://localhost:11434/v1。会自动拼接 /chat/completions。

apiKey.name: API Key
apiKey.description: 以 Bearer 方式发送。明文保存在 plugins/data 中；介意时请使用本地或自建端点。

model.name: 模型
model.description: 随每次请求发送的模型 ID，例如 gpt-4o-mini、deepseek-chat、qwen-plus。

timeoutSeconds.name: 请求超时（秒）
timeoutSeconds.description: 等待一次回答的最长时间。推理模型较慢，240 秒是合理默认值。

autoStart.name: 启动后自动启用
autoStart.description: 自动创建一张默认隐藏的 LLM 桥接插件纸片，用于保持全局待办按钮和顶栏按钮可用。

systemPrompt.name: 系统提示词
systemPrompt.description: 每次请求都作为 system 消息发送。留空则不发送。

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: 随请求发送的采样温度。-1 表示完全不携带该字段（推理模型建议保持 -1）。

ja.name: LLM ブリッジ
ja.description: PaperTodo のタスクや紙の内容を OpenAI 互換 LLM（Base URL + API キー）に送信し、回答をノートに書き込みます。

baseUrl.name: Base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI 互換 API のルート URL。/chat/completions は自動的に付加されます。

apiKey.name: API キー
apiKey.description: Bearer トークンとして送信され、plugins/data に平文で保存されます。

model.name: モデル
model.description: リクエストごとに送信されるモデル ID。

autoStart.name: 起動時に有効化
autoStart.description: 非表示の LLM ブリッジ紙を自動作成し、グローバルボタンを利用可能に保ちます。

systemPrompt.name: システムプロンプト
systemPrompt.description: 毎回 system メッセージとして送信されます。空なら送信しません。

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: -1 はフィールド自体を送信しません（推論モデルに推奨）。

ko.name: LLM 브리지
ko.description: PaperTodo 할 일과 종이 내용을 OpenAI 호환 LLM(Base URL + API 키)으로 보내고, 답변을 노트에 기록합니다.

baseUrl.name: Base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI 호환 API 루트 URL입니다. /chat/completions 가 자동으로 붙습니다.

apiKey.name: API 키
apiKey.description: Bearer 토큰으로 전송되며 plugins/data 에 평문으로 저장됩니다.

autoStart.name: 시작 시 활성화
autoStart.description: 숨겨진 LLM 브리지 종이를 자동으로 만들어 전역 버튼을 유지합니다.

systemPrompt.name: 시스템 프롬프트
systemPrompt.description: 매 요청에 system 메시지로 전송됩니다. 비워 두면 전송하지 않습니다.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: -1이면 필드 자체를 보내지 않습니다(추론 모델 권장).
